observations:
Torah #281 is a three-sentence teaching with a single thematic idea: the miraculous illumination and combination of Torah letters when a person gazes at them carefully. The source text contains one explicit bechina equation — the shining/combining Torah letters are 'בִּבְחִינַת אוֹתִיּוֹת בּוֹלְטוֹת וּמִצְטָרְפוֹת' (Yoma 73b). A third closely related concept is 'צֵרוּפִים חֲדָשִׁים' (new combinations), which is the experiential output of the same phenomenon.

The threshold for proposing a new package per the algorithm is: 3+ concepts connected by explicit bechina language forming an independent domain. This teaching has the three concepts (אוֹתִיּוֹת הַתּוֹרָה, אוֹתִיּוֹת בּוֹלְטוֹת וּמִצְטָרְפוֹת, צֵרוּפִים חֲדָשִׁים), and they are bechina-connected (they all share the essential nature of 'letters that miraculously illuminate and combine'). However, given that the entire teaching consists of only these three sentences and no bechina edges exist in torahData.js for Torah #281 at all, proposing a new package here would require creating the underlying dataset entries first. The correct workflow is:

1. Add the two bechina edges to torahData.js:
   - אוֹתִיּוֹת הַתּוֹרָה ↔ אוֹתִיּוֹת בּוֹלְטוֹת וּמִצְטָרְפוֹת (explicit bechina language in the text)
   - אוֹתִיּוֹת בּוֹלְטוֹת וּמִצְטָרְפוֹת ↔ צֵרוּפִים חֲדָשִׁים (the combinations are the shining letters expressed)
2. Then the connected-component algorithm would yield one component of 3 nodes forming a single package.

Since the package framework requires the bechina subgraph to exist before packages can be built from it, and since the subgraph for Torah #281 is currently empty, NO NEW PACKAGES are proposed at this stage. The gap additions in torah_281_additions.json document the two missing bechina edges and three missing nodes that would constitute this future package.

Polarity of the prospective package: good — the illuminated Torah letters and their miraculous combinations are unambiguously in the domain of holiness. The teaching presents this as a positive spiritual phenomenon accessible even to the simple person. No evil mirror is present or implied in this very short teaching.
